tweets: External contracts can seize execution control flow when called.
In reentrancy attacks, they call back before the initial invocation finishes.
These recursive callbacks let separate function invocations interact undesirably.
The Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern updates state before making external calls.
Using OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard prevents protected functions from executing recursively.
